No Vitruvian UVs or HumanShaders/VitruvianGodot PNGs are consumed.

`vitruvian_pore_tile.py` takes a topology-free cheek crop, high-passes and wrap-blends it into a tangent-normal tile; `materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py:patch_glb_skin_shade` embeds that tile in Aisha's GLB as `OPENCLINXR_skin_shade.detailNormalTexture` with `KHR_texture_transform` scale 90.
**Keep.** CC0 is the cleanest posture. Re-run the deterministic tile station from the sha-pinned EXR if the derivative moves; replace only on measured texture-quality grounds.
